🔒 Practice Local System Architecture In production, this panel interfaces with the practice's encrypted local database (PostgreSQL/SQLite with AES-256) inside the local practice network. Inquiries are purged from the central delivery queue immediately upon confirmed local receipt. The system scales to several thousand patients with verified backups, recovery procedures, and immutable audit logs.
